steps.path: A wide popup (like Development or a Marketplace item) with a main action and Cancel
steps.headline: In a wide popup, where do the two buttons sit?
steps.notice: You said stacking looks worse in wide popups. Filled stays on the right either way.

variants.label: Pair on the right
variants.summary: Both hug their labels at the right edge.

steps.path: A narrow popup or a phone, with the buttons stacked
steps.headline: When the buttons stack, is the main button on top or at the bottom?
steps.notice: You said stacking looks good in narrow popups and on phones.

variants.label: Main on top
variants.summary: The filled button first, Cancel under it.

variants.label: Main at the bottom
variants.summary: Cancel first, the filled button last — nearest your thumb on a phone.
